# airflow_role (List Resource)

Lists all Airflow roles. Use with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later) to enumerate existing roles. On Airflow 3 roles are read from the auth manager API (`auth_manager_base_path`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "airflow_role" "all" {
  provider         = airflow
  include_resource = true
}
```
